text: Don't wait ... Buy!. So darling and practical because it's microwaveable and dish washer safe,not mention beautiful,perfect cup size. I love it!

product_metadata.title: Lenox French Perle Tea Set, 7-piece, White -
features: 7 pieces tea set (9 pieces with the Lids). Only available in white.
Made of durable stoneware. Dishwasher & Microwave Safe
The rims feature a hand-applied tea stain finish.
Backed by a lifetime breakage replacement program from Lenox.
description: A complete tea set, with a 48 oz teapot, 2 cups, 2 saucers, a creamer and a sugar, perfectly blend classic and contemporary styling. It makes a beautiful centerpiece for an afternoon party and a great gift. Crafted of elegant stoneware, this essential addition to the French Perle Collection will help you to brew up many good times!
